q01:
SELECT 
    r.name AS region,
    SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(SUM(refunds.amount_cents), 0)) AS revenue_cents
FROM 
    orders od
JOIN 
    customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
LEFT JOIN 
    order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
LEFT JOIN 
    refunds ON od.order_id = refunds.order_id AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01' AND od.ordered_at <= '2026-08-01'
WHERE 
    od.status <> 'cancelled' 
    AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    r.region_id
HAVING 
    SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(SUM(refunds.amount_cents), 0)) > 0
ORDER BY 
    r.region_id

q06:

    orders od

    customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id

    regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id

    order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id

    AND od.deleted_at IS NULL

    AND od.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'

    r.region_id

q13:
WITH fiscal_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-07-31' THEN 'FQ2'
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' THEN 'FQ3'
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' THEN 'FQ3'
            WHEN ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-31' THEN 'FQ3'
        END AS fiscal_quarter
    FROM orders
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.fiscal_quarter,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents - COALESCE(r.amount_cents, 0)) AS revenue_cents
    FROM fiscal_periods fp
    JOIN orders o ON fp.fiscal_quarter IS NOT NULL AND o.ordered_at = fp.fiscal_quarter
    JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY fp.fiscal_quarter
)
SELECT 
    fiscal_quarter,
    revenue_cents
FROM net_revenue
ORDER BY fiscal_quarter
q14:
WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        ol.order_id,
        SUM(ol.qty * ol.amount_cents) AS total_amount_cents,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS total_refund_amount_cents
    FROM
        order_lines ol
    LEFT JOIN
        refunds r ON ol.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY
        ol.order_id
),
filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.ordered_at,
        ot.total_amount_cents,
        ot.total_refund_amount_cents
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        order_totals ot ON o.order_id = ot.order_id
    WHERE
        o.status <> 'cancelled' AND
        o.deleted_at IS NULL AND
        o.ordered_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_amount_cents - total_refund_amount_cents) AS avg_revenue_cents
FROM
    filtered_orders

refunds_subtracted AS (
    SELECT 
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS total_refund_cents
    FROM 
        refunds r
    WHERE 
        r.refunded_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-08-01'

        r.order_id
),
net_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fo.order_id,
        fo.total_amount_cents - COALESCE(rs.total_refund_cents, 0) AS net_total_amount_cents
    FROM 
        filtered_orders fo
    LEFT JOIN 
        refunds_subtracted rs ON fo.order_id = rs.order_id
)
SELECT 
    order_id, 
    net_total_amount_cents AS amount_cents
FROM 
    net_revenue
ORDER BY 
    net_total_amount_cents DESC

q33:
WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at) AS month,
        SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.ordered_at >= '2026-05-01'
      AND o.ordered_at < '2026-09-01'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered_at)
), refund_adjustment AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', r.refunded_at) AS month,
        SUM(r.amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND r.refunded_at >= '2026-05-01'
      AND r.refunded_at < '2026-09-01'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', r.refunded_at)
)
SELECT
    OR.month,
    COALESCE(OR.revenue_cents, 0) - COALESCE(RA.refund_cents, 0) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM order_revenue OR
LEFT JOIN refund_adjustment RA ON OR.month = RA.month
WHERE COALESCE(OR.revenue_cents, 0) - COALESCE(RA.refund_cents, 0) > 0
ORDER BY OR.month
